stemMd: The ordered data are 2, 4, 7, 9, 12. The largest value is replaced by 120. What happens to the median?
explanationMd: With five ordered observations, the median is the third. Replacing the largest observation by an even larger one does not change the third position, so the median stays 7.

distractorRationale.e: The largest value is not the median.
distractorRationale.c: This is the new mean, not median.
distractorRationale.b: The median is not half the largest value.
distractorRationale.a: There are still two values on each side of 7.
